# `broken_seeded.geojson` — seeded fault map

Eight features, **exactly one seeded fault each**, everything else about each
feature deliberately clean so the validator catches one finding per feature and
**no false positives**. This file is the primary regression oracle: each fault
class below must produce the stated finding code at the stated severity.

| idx | ProducerName | Seeded fault | Expected code | Severity |
|-----|--------------|--------------|---------------|----------|
| 0 | Grace Wambui | Property casing: `producername` instead of `ProducerName` | `PROP_CASING_MISMATCH` | ERROR |
| 1 | Henry Kiprop | ISO3 country code `KEN` (should be ISO2 `KE`) | `PROP_COUNTRY_IS_ISO3` | ERROR |
| 2 | Irene Chebet | String-typed `"Area": "1.1"` (Excel-export fault) | `PROP_AREA_NOT_NUMBER` | ERROR |
| 3 | James Mutua | Unclosed polygon ring (first ≠ last; 4 distinct pts) | `GEOM_RING_NOT_CLOSED` | ERROR |
| 4 | Kevin Omondi | Self-intersecting bow-tie polygon | `GEOM_SELF_INTERSECTION` | ERROR |
| 5 | Lucy Njoki | `LineString` geometry (rejected type) | `GEOM_TYPE_REJECTED` | ERROR |
| 6 | Moses Barasa | Longitude out of range (`210.5`) | `GEOM_COORD_OUT_OF_RANGE` | ERROR |
| 7 | Nancy Auma | Swapped lon/lat — KE producer, coords outside KE, un-swap lands **inside** KE | `GEOM_COORDS_LIKELY_SWAPPED` | **ERROR** (tier 2) |

## Notes for the validator (so each stays a single finding)

- **idx 0** — the case-variant must be reported as `PROP_CASING_MISMATCH` (naming found `producername` vs expected `ProducerName`), **not** as a generic `PROP_MISSING`.
- **idx 2** — a non-numeric `Area` emits `PROP_AREA_NOT_NUMBER` and the numeric-dependent checks (threshold rule 18, polygon consistency 17) must **skip** this feature, not emit a second finding.
- **idx 3** — 4 distinct points, so check 9 (≥4 pairs) passes; only closure (check 8) fails.
- **idx 6** — longitude out of range emits `GEOM_COORD_OUT_OF_RANGE`; the swap heuristic (check 6) must **not** also run on an out-of-range coordinate.
- **idx 7** — this is the tier-2 (ERROR) swap case: un-swapping `[-0.42, 36.95]` gives `[36.95, -0.42]`, which is inside Kenya, so the swap is near-certain. Tier-1 (WARNING, "possibly swapped") is exercised separately in `swap_tiers.geojson`. The message must distinguish "almost certainly swapped" (this case) from "possibly swapped".

Generated by `_build_fixtures.py`, which asserts every one of these properties
against shapely/pyproj before writing the file.
